content.comment_body: I've previously set up a connection with [product_name], but this project involves three modules instead of a single diagram. Now, when I try to specify connection details in the Tools-Ethernet connections menu, that option isn't available… [IMAGE]

In network mode, access to Ethernet connection settings is different compared to diagram mode. The connection properties are accessible directly on the line connecting [product_name] to another device. Double-clicking this line opens the relevant properties.

This refers to the connection between [product_name] modules. What I'm trying to achieve is a connection to an external [product_name] (to read data or conditions). Do I need to configure this within the network setup? [IMAGE]
Add an [product_name] device to your network project, and then establish a connection between the existing [product_name] module and the new device.

analysis.insight_summary: Users face challenges accessing Ethernet connection options in [product_name] software when working in network mode with multiple modules. The expected configuration menu from single diagram mode is unavailable, causing confusion on how to connect to external devices like [product_name] PLCs. Resolution involves adapting to new workflow steps for network configurations.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to access and modify Ethernet connection details through the same interface as in diagram mode, even when working with multiple modules in network mode. They wish to easily establish connections to both internal and external devices, such as [product_name] PLCs.
